Birth Certificate — Apply & Download Guide

• Last updated: 2026-09-15 · 3 min read
Share:
In simple words:

Birth Certificate ek official document hai jo child ke birth ki date, place aur parents ki details record karta hai. Yeh lifetime identity document hai aur school admission, Aadhaar, passport, property rights — sabke liye zaroori hai.

S
Samjho Content Team ✓

Trusted and policy experts simplifying MSME, tax, and compliance for India. Verified by Chartered Accountants.

Simple explanation

Birth Certificate sarkar dwara issue kiya jaata hai aur yeh prove karta hai ki ek child kab aur kahan paida hua, aur uske parents kaun hain. Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 ke under har birth ko 21 din ke andar register karna compulsory hai.

Apply karne ke liye aap apne state ke CRS (Civil Registration System) portal par ja sakte hain ya nearest municipal corporation / Nagar Nigam office mein. Hospital mein birth hui hai toh hospital se discharge ke saath hi birth certificate ka process start ho jaata hai.

Required documents: Hospital discharge slip / birth proof, parents ka ID proof (Aadhaar), parents ka marriage certificate, aur address proof. Late registration (21 din ke baad) mein additional affidavit aur late fee lag sakti hai.

Aaj kal kai states mein birth certificate online download bhi ho sakta hai — CRS portal ya state municipal website par. Name enter karke ya registration number se search karke aap printable copy le sakte hain.

Why does it matter?

Birth certificate ek lifetime document hai — bina iske school admission, Aadhaar card, PAN card, passport, driving licence — kuch bhi nahi ho sakta. Yeh child ki age, citizenship aur parentage ka sabse important legal proof hai. Early registration se baad mein koi problem nahi aati.

Example

In numbers

Aapke ghar ek baby paida hua hai. Hospital se discharge milne se pehle hospital administration ko birth registration form bharein — hospital khud municipal authority ko report karta hai. 21 din ke andar register ho jaata hai aur aap birth certificate download kar sakte hain. Agar 21 din nikal gaye, toh late registration mein affidavit aur late fee lagegi.

Important things to know

  • Har birth ko 21 din ke andar register karna compulsory hai (Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969).
  • Hospital birth: Hospital khud registration process start karta hai — parents ko form bharna hota hai.
  • Home birth: Nearest municipal corporation / Nagar Nigam office mein jaake register karna padta hai.
  • Required documents: Hospital discharge slip, parents' ID proof, marriage certificate, address proof.
  • Late registration (21 din ke baad): Additional affidavit, late fee, aur magistrate order lag sakta hai.
  • Birth certificate online download: CRS portal ya state municipal website se ho sakta hai.
  • Correction (naam, DOB, parents ki details): Municipal office mein application deni hoti hai with supporting proof.
  • Duplicate copy bhi download ya apply ho sakti hai — original kho jaane par.

Common mistakes

  • 21 din ka deadline miss karna — late registration mein extra paperwork aur fees lagti hai.
  • Naam ki spelling galat likhwana — baad mein school / Aadhaar se mismatch ho sakta hai, correction mein time lagta hai.
  • Hospital discharge slip na sambhal ke rakhna — yeh birth proof ke roop mein primary document hai.
  • Home birth ko register na karna — legal requirement hai, bina certificate ke child ko future mein problems aayengi.
  • Online portal par galat details enter karna — jo bhi form bharein woh hospital records se exactly match hona chahiye.

Frequently asked questions

Birth certificate ke liye online apply kaise karein?

Apne state ke CRS portal ya municipal corporation website par jaayein. 'Birth Registration' ya 'Apply for Birth Certificate' section mein form bharein. Hospital details, parents ki details, child ki details enter karein. Documents upload karein aur submit karein. Registered number se status track ho sakta hai.

Birth certificate download kaise karein?

CRS portal ya state municipal website par 'Search Birth Certificate' section mein jaayein. Child ka naam, date of birth, registration number ya parents ka naam enter karein. Matching record milne par printable PDF download ho jaata hai.

Late registration (21 din ke baad) kaise karein?

Nearest municipal office mein application dein with late fee. 1 month se 1 saal late hai toh late fee + affidavit lagta hai. 1 saal se zyada late hai toh magistrate order bhi lag sakta hai. Process state-wise vary karta hai.

Birth certificate mein correction kaise karwayein?

Municipal corporation office mein correction application dein with supporting documents (hospital records, school records etc.). Naam spelling fix, DOB correction, parents ki details fix — sab correction possible hai. Process 2-4 weeks lag sakta hai.

Birth certificate duplicate kaise milega?

Agar original kho gaya hai, toh CRS portal se download karein ya municipal office mein duplicate copy ke liye apply karein. Registration number ya child ka naam + DOB lagta hai search ke liye. Duplicate copy original jitni hi valid hoti hai.

Home birth ka birth certificate kaise banega?

Nearest municipal corporation / Nagar Nigam office mein jaayein. Parents ka ID proof, address proof, aur ek affidavit dena hota hai ki child ghar par paida hua hai. Municipal authority verify karke birth certificate issue karegi.
